MEYA HOLDINGS LTD is an international company specializing in digital assets, cryptocurrency markets, and financial research. We focus on developing data-driven trading approaches and optimizing market operations. Our remote team brings together professionals from different parts of the world.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Market Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency or financial trading. You will assist with market analysis, monitor trading performance, and contribute to improving our daily operational processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor cryptocurrency prices, trading volumes, and market developments.
  • Analyze market data and identify potential trading opportunities.
  • Assist with daily Spot, Futures, and Options trading activities.
  • Monitor asset allocation across centralized and decentralized exchanges.
  • Prepare reports on market conditions and trading performance.
  • Identify operational or technical issues and coordinate with the relevant teams.
  • Monitor automated trading systems and ensure compliance with risk management rules.
  • Maintain accurate financial and operational records.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to improve trading processes.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with no geographical restrictions.
  • Flexible working hours across different time zones.
  • Access to professional trading platforms and analytical tools.
  • Opportunity to gain practical experience in digital asset markets.
  • Career development opportunities within an international company.
  • Friendly working environment with ongoing support and feedback.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency, trading, or financial analysis.
  • Knowledge of centralized and decentralized exchanges (CEX and DEX).
  • Basic understanding of technical analysis and market indicators.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and responsibility.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with a remote team.

Apply here:

https://meyameta.com/work/remoteok

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.
    • At least 1 year of home health care experience.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills
